name: killproc
description: Terminates a process running on a specified port

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port number to kill the process on (e.g., 5199, 3000, 8080)

examples.description: Kills the process listening on port 5199
Kills the process listening on port 3000

implementation.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort {port} -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } ; Write-Host "Process on port {port} terminated successfully"
